limitations: The frozen court's exact full-pipeline null-action comparator passed, but the negative-control promotion gate failed. Public rank-truncated aligned inference therefore remains approximate, fails closed by default, and requires an explicit override; this review does not certify nominal FWER for that public approximate path.

The subject is the sampling and exchangeability unit. Sign-flip inference requires joint subject-row sign invariance across the complete prespecified contrast-by-location family; locations and contrasts within a row are not independent sampling units.

An independent_data_hash is an auditable provenance identifier, not empirical proof that the supplied feature acquisition is statistically independent of the estimation data. That independence remains a caller-owned design claim.

The same-data residualized feature mode establishes covariance orthogonality only under the declared separable effect-by-parcel covariance model and conditional on fixed generating directions. The preprocessing receipt verifies the implemented transforms, not separability in an observed cohort, and the estimated rank-truncated directions leave this mode approximate.
Aligned group inference has an equal-subject estimand. MFA or energy weights affect pooled-moment estimation only and are not inverse-variance weights for, or imported into, the aligned group test.

The known-warp study is a finite 40-cohort efficacy and numerical study, not evidence of power superiority. All solver rows converged and serial/parallel replay passed, but the iterative template converged in 39 of 40 cohorts and the observed rejection rates do not establish a power advantage.

The exact package check intentionally used --ignore-vignettes. Executable and rendered documentation is covered by the separately source-bound, UTF-8-gated exact-tarball pkgdown receipt rather than by the R CMD check vignette phase.
Parametric aligned inference remains a cellwise one-sample t approximation requiring independent subjects and an adequate normal approximation; it does not provide a max-T randomization distribution.
